name: Any3R predicted-pose geometry benchmark (PP13)
description: 3 datasets x 13 central camera models x 24 scenes x 3 views. Each view is rendered natively through the camera model from a source panorama (the pool's erp_rgb, already round-tripped through that camera at the builder's sensor size); every method reconstructs with its own predicted poses; Acc / Comp / NC after one Sim(3) fit and PanoVGGT's eval_pointcloud (Umeyama + rigid ICP), pose AUC from the relative poses of the view pairs.
array_hash: md5 of the C-contiguous bytes of the array as stored in the pool npz (dtype and shape listed)

render.rule: erp and cylindrical: W = 360 deg, H = 180 deg; other cameras square, side = fov; at px_per_deg, each side floored to a multiple of patch
render.camera: any3r.cameras.from_fov(kind, W, H, fov, principal_point=((W-1)/2, (H-1)/2), circular=True)
render.gt_mask: lens valid & source mask (nearest) & source range (bilinear) > 0.05 m

roundtrip.rule: sensor with px_per_sr pixels per steradian of the camera's solid angle; 2:1 for erp and cylindrical, square otherwise; even sides

metrics.acc: cell mean over scenes of PanoVGGT eval_pointcloud Acc-mean
metrics.auc: AUC over all view pairs of the cell of max(rotation, translation-direction error), 1-degree bins
